description: C17 write scope -- the shell verb table harness_write_scope.py reads to find the WRITE TARGETS of a Bash/PowerShell command (C2). Which folders a session may write to is project policy: casan-policies.yaml -> write_scope.
enforcement_note: HONEST STATUS (C10): file tools (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit) are checked exactly. Shell commands are checked by pattern: a target written as a literal, a variable assigned in the same command, or inside a script file the command runs. A path computed at run time (Join-Path, string building, a program's own default such as pytest's basetemp) is invisible; the after-command detection reports entries that appear in the drive root or beside the project. Defense-in-depth, not a boundary -- the only hard boundary is a restricted OS account.
